_description: Training configuration of the D3QN baseline (double dueling DQN with n-step returns), read from the metadata of the model used in the paper (src/baselines/models/drl_dqn.pt). Training took 557 s on the CPU described in the README. Retraining is not needed to reproduce the paper: the experiments load the shipped model. Because of floating-point non-associativity in PyTorch, a retrained model is statistically equivalent but not bit-identical.
